name: Flow
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

name.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID is moduleName + flowName + componentName + componentType. Override it when multiple flows should share a configuration, or when renaming a flow without changing configuration already stored in the override-properties database.

flowStartupType.helpText:
Controls this flow on module activation: AUTOMATIC starts it, MANUAL waits for an explicit operator start, and DISABLED prevents starting it. Use Studio or the module-local Blue Console and supported runtime controls to manage flows.

Studio generates a per-flow ikasan.module.activator.startup.type.flowStartupTypes[index]=Flow Name,MANUAL entry; the module property sets defaultStartupType separately. Through AI proposals use setFlowProperty with property flowStartupType.

Leave flows with missing external setup on MANUAL, including both sides of an unavailable transport pair, and describe the prerequisites. Do not auto-start placeholder credentials. Keep independent ready flows usable.

Persisted database startup controls can take precedence over new properties. Check the effective runtime setting; allowDbOverwrite defaults to false. Do not globally enable overwrite or erase operator settings just to make a demo pass. MANUAL does not bypass Spring bean creation or validate missing implementations.

isRecording.helpText: Records events received by this flow so that they can be inspected and replayed. Recording uses persistent storage and should be enabled deliberately.

recordedEventTimeToLive.helpText: The number of days recorded flow events are retained before housekeeping removes them. Ikasan defaults this value to 30 days.

invokeContextListeners.helpText: Invokes configured flow context listeners, including timing and message-history listeners. Enabling this can add processing and persistence overhead.

testHarnessDestination.helpText: Private JMS destination used by the test reader and its producer while this harness exists. The producer's configured destination is preserved.

testHarnessOwner.helpText: Studio-internal bookkeeping only, never shown to the user and never passed to the Ikasan builder. Identifies this flow as a JMS test-consumer harness (see CreateTestJmsConsumerFlowAction) and names the producer it was created for, as '<flow identity>/<component identity>'. The canvas hides any flow with this set from normal rendering and draws a compact harness node against the owning producer instead (see TestJmsHarnessLinks).
